title: Prose standards carry a deterministic holdout and retire automatically when they show no effect
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 10: no record can be retired; ADR 0002 requires operator promotion.
Outcome: hash(task,record) 10% holdout per prose record; krn standards retire generates a PR setting valid_to for records with >=30 exposures and no served-vs-withheld difference; ADR 0002 amended (auto trial + retire, operator veto).
Proof: deterministic holdout test; retire PR generated on fixture exposures.
Blocked on: operator decision (ADR 0002 amendment).
Decision d-1982f6 closed 2026-11-14 by Fable under operator grant: auto trial + retire with operator veto; amend ADR 0002 in this task.
